repos.description: 🐹 Clean, uninstall, analyze, optimize, and monitor your Mac. Free open-source CLI, plus a native Mac app.
repos.summary_zh: Mole 是一款 macOS 深度清理优化工具，集成 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner 等工具功能于一身。支持深度清理缓存日志、智能卸载应用及其残留文件、可视化磁盘分析、实时系统监控，并提供一键优化系统服务。通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装，提供交互式菜单与命令行操作，支持预览清理计划、白名单管理及详细调试日志，兼顾高效性与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Mole is a comprehensive macOS optimization tool combining features of CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus. It enables deep cleaning of caches/logs, smart app uninstallation with leftover removal, visual disk analysis, real-time system monitoring, and system service optimization. Installed via Homebrew or script, it offers interactive menus and CLI commands with dry-run previews, whitelist management, and detailed debug logging for safe and efficient system maintenance.

repos.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。
repos.summary_zh: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情监控工具，支持多平台热点聚合、RSS 订阅与智能关键词筛选，提供 AI 翻译与分析简报推送。集成微信/飞书/钉钉等 8+ 通知渠道，支持 Docker 部署与 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测，30 秒快速部署。
repos.summary_en: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool that aggregates multi-platform hot topics, RSS feeds, and offers smart keyword filtering. It delivers AI-translated analysis briefs via 8+ notification channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, etc.), supports Docker deployment and MCP architecture for AI-driven sentiment analysis and trend forecasting, with a 30-second setup.

repos.description: Developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring
repos.summary_zh: Sentry 是一款开发者优先的错误追踪与性能监控平台，提供实时问题检测、错误追踪、性能分析和用户行为回放功能，支持 20+ 编程语言和框架的官方 SDK，助力团队快速定位并修复代码缺陷。
repos.summary_en: Sentry is a developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring platform that enables real-time issue detection, error tracing, performance insights, and user session replay. It supports 20+ languages via official SDKs, helping teams debug and resolve problems faster.

repos.description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
repos.summary_zh: Vorssaint 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具箱，旨在替代多个付费系统工具。它集成了应用独立音量调节、系统资源监控、窗口切换、剪贴板历史、文件暂存架及应用卸载等十余项功能。所有功能均本地运行，无需账户或订阅，通过单一图标即可访问，极大提升了 Mac 用户的操作效率。
repos.summary_en: Vorssaint is a free, open-source macOS menu bar toolkit designed to replace a stack of paid utilities. It integrates over a dozen features including per-app volume mixing, system monitoring, window switching, clipboard history, and app uninstallation. Running entirely locally with no accounts or subscriptions, it consolidates multiple tools into a single, efficient menu bar icon.

repos.description: Show usage stats for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, without having to login.
repos.summary_zh: CodexBar 是一款 macOS 14+ 菜单栏应用，实时显示 OpenAI Codex、Claude Code 等主流 AI 服务的令牌/额度使用情况（会话+周额度），支持多提供商独立或合并显示，无需登录即可查看窗口重置时间，提供本地成本扫描与状态监控功能。
repos.summary_en: CodexBar is a tiny macOS 14+ menu bar app that displays token/credit usage (session + weekly) for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and other AI providers without requiring login. It supports per-provider toggles, merge icons mode, local cost scanning, and real-time reset countdowns via a compact two-bar meter icon.

repos.description: CAT 作为服务端项目基础组件，提供了 Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go 等多语言客户端，已经在美团点评的基础架构中间件框架（MVC框架，RPC框架，数据库框架，缓存框架等，消息队列，配置系统等）深度集成，为美团点评各业务线提供系统丰富的性能指标、健康状况、实时告警等。
repos.summary_zh: CAT 是美团点评开源的实时应用监控平台，支持 Java、C/C++、Node.js、Python、Go 等多语言客户端，提供 Transaction、Event、Heartbeat、Metric 四种监控模型。其核心优势在于秒级实时数据处理、全量数据采集、高可用部署及高吞吐扩展能力，广泛应用于服务端性能监控、故障定位与业务优化。
repos.summary_en: CAT is a real-time application monitoring platform developed by Meituan-Dianping, offering multi-language clients (Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go) and supporting four monitoring models: Transaction, Event, Heartbeat, and Metric. It excels in sub-minute real-time processing, full-data collection, high availability, and scalable distributed deployment, enabling comprehensive performance tracking, fault detection, and system optimization across enterprise infrastructure.

repos.description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
repos.summary_zh: Vorssaint 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具集，以单一图标整合音量混音、系统监控、窗口管理、剪贴板历史、文本片段等多项实用功能。模块化设计支持按需安装卸载，零账户、零遥测、零订阅，专为用户隐私和性能效率而构建。
repos.summary_en: Vorssaint is a free, open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume mixing, system monitoring, window management, clipboard history, and more into a single lightweight icon. Fully modular, privacy-first with zero telemetry or subscriptions, and requires macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon.

repos.description: chat log tool, easily use your own chat data. 聊天记录工具，轻松使用自己的聊天数据
repos.summary_zh: chatlog 是一款聊天记录工具，旨在帮助用户轻松管理和使用自己的聊天数据。由于微信官方函件指出其核心功能存在合规风险，项目于2025年10月20日被主动移除，仅保留说明文件。用户无法再获取代码或支持，建议删除本地副本以规避法律风险。
repos.summary_en: Chatlog was a chat log tool designed to help users easily manage and utilize their own chat data. Due to compliance risks identified in an official letter from WeChat, the project was voluntarily removed on October 20, 2025. Only this notice remains; no code, binaries, or support are available. Users are advised to delete any local copies to avoid legal issues.

repos.description: Intelligent adaptive brightness for your external monitors
repos.summary_zh: Lunar 是一款专为 macOS 设计的显示器控制应用，支持通过 DDC/CI 协议直接调节外接显示器亮度、音量、输入源及屏幕方向。其核心亮点包括传感器/同步/位置自适应亮度调节、XDR/HDR 高亮度支持、低于 0% 的暗光模式、App 预设配置及 BlackOut 功能（关闭屏幕同时保留充电、音频等功能），完美兼容 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 芯片。
repos.summary_en: Lunar is a macOS app for controlling external monitors via DDC/CI, enabling hardware-level brightness, volume, input switching, and orientation adjustments. Key features include sensor/sync/location-based adaptive brightness, support for 1000–1600 nits XDR/HDR displays, sub-zero dimming, app-specific presets, and BlackOut mode—preserving charging, audio, and input while turning off screens. Fully compatible with both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.

repos.description: 一个基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Durable Objects 的免费多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时监控、离线告警，到期通知，历史数据查看、延迟追踪、地图展示等功能。兼容主流Linux系统，Alpine Linux，OpenWrt，macOS，群晖 DSM、飞牛 fnOS、Windows系统。
repos.summary_zh: CF-Server-Monitor 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时追踪 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络等指标，提供历史图表、全球地图展示、离线告警及 WebSocket 实时推送。兼容 Linux、Alpine、OpenWrt 和 Windows 系统，集成 JWT 认证与 Turnstile 人机验证，通过 GitHub Actions 实现一键部署，适合运维自动化与多节点监控场景。
repos.summary_en: CF-Server-Monitor is a multi-server monitoring probe system built on Cloudflare Workers and D1, offering real-time tracking of CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics with historical charts, global map visualization, offline alerts, and WebSocket-based live updates. Compatible with Linux, Alpine, OpenWrt, and Windows, it integrates JWT authentication and Turnflare Turnstile verification, enabling one-click deployment via GitHub Actions for efficient operations automation and multi-node monitoring.

repos.description: Check酱：监测网页内容变化，并发送异动到微信。亦支持http status、json和rss监测。配合自架云端，关电脑后也能运行。
repos.summary_zh: Check酱是一款网页内容监控工具，支持通过浏览器插件监测网页内容变化，并将异动推送至微信等消息通道。支持HTTP状态、JSON和RSS监测，配合自建云端服务可实现24小时运行。具备可视化选择器、周期任务调度及多平台部署能力。
repos.summary_en: Check酱 is a web content monitoring tool that detects changes on web pages via a browser plugin and sends alerts to WeChat or other channels. It supports HTTP status, JSON, and RSS monitoring, with optional cloud deployment for continuous operation. Features include visual selector, scheduled tasks, and multi-platform support.

repos.description: Every display control macOS hides, in one menu bar app: sharp HiDPI/Retina scaling (no more blurry or tiny text), DDC brightness and volume, Extra Brightness past 100%, presets, virtual displays. Free and open source, a no-cost alternative to BetterDisplay and Lunar.
repos.summary_zh: Crisp是免费开源的macOS外接显示器控制面板，提供锐利HiDPI缩放、DDC亮度调节、显示器预设与虚拟屏幕等功能，替代BetterDisplay等付费工具，提升多屏显示体验。
repos.summary_en: Crisp is a free, open-source external monitor control app for macOS, offering sharp HiDPI scaling, DDC brightness control, display presets and virtual displays as an alternative to paid tools like BetterDisplay.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款开源免费的 macOS 原生系统管理工具，集垃圾清理、应用卸载、磁盘分析、重复文件查找和实时状态监控于一体。内置 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 代理安全可控地监控和维护 Mac，所有操作可审计、可回滚。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS system management tool that combines junk cleanup, app uninstallation, disk analysis, duplicate finding, and live status monitoring. It features a built-in MCP server for AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor to safely monitor and maintain your Mac, with all actions consent-gated, audited, and reversible.

repos.description: A Django app that keeps a log of changes made to an object.
repos.summary_zh: django-auditlog 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，用于自动记录模型对象的所有变更，包括操作用户、变更摘要及详细 JSON 数据，支持灵活查询与审计追踪，适用于需要完整操作日志的场景。
repos.summary_en: django-auditlog is a lightweight Django app that automatically logs all changes to model objects, capturing the actor, change summary, and detailed JSON data for flexible auditing and traceability.

repos.description: A free and open-source collection of native macOS menu bar tools.
repos.summary_zh: MacTools 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS 菜单栏工具集，提供系统状态监控、活动统计、快捷控制（显示/音频/电源）等插件面板。支持自定义组件排列、多主题切换（兼容 iTerm2/Base16）及插件市场扩展，界面深度适配 macOS 原生风格，基于 SwiftUI 构建，要求 macOS 14+
repos.summary_en: MacTools is a free, open-source native macOS menu bar toolkit offering system status widgets, activity analytics, and quick controls for display, audio, and power. It features a plugin marketplace, draggable custom panels, light/dark theme support (including iTerm2 and Base16 palettes), and a polished SwiftUI-based interface requiring macOS 14+.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents. Coming to Windows
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS GUI 工具，为 Mole CLI 提供可视化操作界面。它集成了磁盘清理、应用卸载、系统优化、磁盘分析及实时状态监控功能，并支持长期历史记录与本地 MCP 服务器，方便 AI 智能体通过自然语言直接操控系统维护任务，即将支持 Windows 平台。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS GUI for the Mole CLI engine. It bundles disk cleaning, app uninstallation, system optimization, disk analysis, and live status monitoring. Featuring long-range history and a local MCP server, it enables AI agents to autonomously diagnose and resolve system issues via natural language, with a Windows version in preview.

repos.description: A tiny macOS menu bar app that tracks your dev servers across projects.
repos.summary_zh: Port Menu 是一款轻量级 macOS 菜单栏应用，专为开发者设计，用于自动追踪跨项目的本地开发服务器。它能实时扫描并展示 Git 仓库名、分支、端口及运行时长，支持一键打开浏览器、复制 URL 或终止进程，无需任何配置即可实现 localhost 服务的可视化管理。
repos.summary_en: Port Menu is a lightweight macOS menu bar app designed for developers to automatically track local development servers across projects. It scans running processes to display Git repo names, branches, ports, and uptime. With zero configuration, it enables one-click access to open in browser, copy URLs, or kill processes directly from the menu bar.

repos.description: Audit log for your Django models
repos.summary_zh: django-audit-log 是一个 Django 模型审计日志库，提供用户追踪、变更记录和会话信息存储功能。支持 Django 1.6/1.7 及多版本 Python，通过中间件自动记录模型创建与修改操作，适用于需要完整操作历史追溯的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-audit-log is a Django model audit logging library that tracks user actions, changes, and session keys for model instances. It supports Django 1.6/1.7, South and Django 1.7 migrations, and both Python 2.x and 3.x, enabling full audit trails for data modifications in web applications.

repos.description: top, but for the HTTP endpoints on your host — a live dashboard of the most active plaintext HTTP endpoints, right in the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: httpinspect 是一款基于 eBPF 的终端实时监控工具，类比 top 命令，直接在内核 TC 层抓取网卡明文 HTTP 请求，按流量、速率和延迟排序展示活跃端点。无需代理、Sidecar 或修改应用代码，支持回环接口监控本地微服务通信，提供 p50/p95/max 延迟、状态码分布及每秒请求数等详细指标。
repos.summary_en: httpinspect is an eBPF-powered terminal live dashboard that ranks plaintext HTTP endpoints by traffic, rate, and latency — like top, but for HTTP. It attaches at the TC layer to read packets directly off the wire with no proxy, sidecar, or application changes. It covers loopback traffic for local microservice chatter and surfaces per-endpoint latency percentiles, status-code mix, and req/s sparklines in a TUI.

repos.description: 一个监控股票的工具
repos.summary_zh: iNeedMyMoneyBack 是一款面向个人投资者的桌面端股票监控工具，支持 A 股、港股、美股及指数的实时行情展示。用户可自定义监控列表、显示字段与刷新频率，并在价格达到目标值时接收系统通知。界面支持表格与滚动模式、全局快捷键、双击跳转行情网站，并内置自动更新组件，适合需要持续关注持仓与大盘动态的股民使用。
repos.summary_en: iNeedMyMoneyBack is a desktop stock monitoring tool for individual investors, providing real-time quotes for A-shares, HK, US stocks, and major indices. Users can customize watchlists, display fields, and refresh intervals, and receive system notifications when target prices are reached. The app supports table and scroll views, global shortcuts, double-click navigation to financial sites, and includes an auto-update component, making it ideal for tracking portfolios and market movements.
